```{r}
clusts <- c("6", "8","2", "4", "1", "5", "3", "9")
srt_subset <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% c(clusts))
srt_subset <- process_all(srt_subset,
                  ref_assay     = proc_params$ref_assay,
                  dims_i        = seq(proc_params$n_pca_dims),
                  k             = proc_params$k_neighbors,
                  res           = 0.1,
                  n_features    = proc_params$n_features,
                  k.nn          = proc_params$n_umap_neighbors,
                  exclude_genes = excluded_genes)


srt_subset_full_cc <- process_all_cc(srt_subset,
                  ref_assay     = proc_params$ref_assay,
                  dims_i        = seq(proc_params$n_pca_dims),
                  k             = proc_params$k_neighbors,
                  res           = 0.1,
                  n_features    = proc_params$n_features,
                  k.nn          = proc_params$n_umap_neighbors,
                  exclude_genes = excluded_genes)

```

Idents(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5

```{r}
clust <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"
mpn_processed_hsc_wt_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_wt_fullcc, 
                                           mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data[colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_wt_fullcc),])
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_wt_fullcc, group.by = clust, label = TRUE,reduction = "umap.nn")+NoLegend()|DimPlot(srt_subset_mchneg_full_cc, group.by = clust, label = TRUE,reduction = "umap.nn")+NoLegend()|DimPlot(srt_subset_mchpos_full_cc, group.by = clust, label = TRUE,reduction = "umap.nn")+NoLegend()|
  DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, group.by = clust, label = TRUE,reduction = "umap.nn")+NoLegend()
```
